metadata.question: Did the Cuyuni River (6.437929, -58.628264) appear lighter in color than the Mazaruni and Essequibo Rivers near their confluence (6.407305, -58.606792) on August 16, 2023?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use Sentinel-2 or Landsat for visible imagery - Date: August 16, 2023 (single day, may need to expand window) - Locations: Two specific points - Cuyuni River and confluence of Mazaruni/Essequibo - Need visible bands to assess "color" - likely RGB composite or use a single band like Red or Green 2. Masking strategy: - Should mask clouds since we want to see actual water color - Use QA bands for cloud masking 3. Logic: - "Lighter in color" means higher reflectance values in visible bands - Compare mean reflectance at both points - Valid Zero: Water can have low reflectance (dark) = valid answer B - Null/Error (C3): If calculation returns None/NaN - Empty (C1): No images found - No pixels (C2): All masked out ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define locations const cuyuniPoint = ee.Geometry.Point([-58.628264, 6.437929]); const confluencePoint = ee.Geometry.Point([-58.606792, 6.407305]); // Buffer points for sampling const cuyuniRegion = cuyuniPoint.buffer(100); const confluenceRegion = confluencePoint.buffer(100); // 2. Define date range (±3 days to increase chances) const startDate = '2023-08-13'; const endDate = '2023-08-19'; console.log('Searching for imagery...'); // 3. Try Sentinel-2 first let collection = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(cuyuniPoint) .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 50)); let size = await collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Sentinel-2 images found: ${size}`); // Fallback to Landsat if no Sentinel-2 if (size === 0) { console.log('Trying Landsat 8/9...'); collection = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .merge(ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2')) .filterBounds(cuyuniPoint) .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 50)); size = await collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Landsat images found: ${size}`); } if (size === 0) { console.log('No images found in date range.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 4. Select best image and mask clouds let image; if (collection.first().bandNames().getInfo().includes('B4')) { // Sentinel-2 image = collection.sort('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE').first(); const qa = image.select('QA60'); const cloudMask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 10).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 11).eq(0)); image = image.updateMask(cloudMask).select(['B2', 'B3', 'B4']); } else { // Landsat image = collection.sort('CLOUD_COVER').first(); const qa = image.select('QA_PIXEL'); const cloudMask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).eq(0)); image = image.updateMask(cloudMask) .select(['SR_B2', 'SR_B3', 'SR_B4'], ['B2', 'B3', 'B4']); } // 5. Calculate brightness (mean of visible bands) const brightness = image.expression('(B2 + B3 + B4) / 3', { 'B2': image.select('B2'), 'B3': image.select('B3'), 'B4': image.select('B4') }); // 6. Sample both locations const cuyuniStats = await brightness.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: cuyuniRegion, scale: 30, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const confluenceStats = await brightness.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: confluenceRegion, scale: 30, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const cuyuniMean = cuyuniStats.mean; const cuyuniCount = cuyuniStats.count; const confluenceMean = confluenceStats.mean; const confluenceCount = confluenceStats.count; console.log(`Cuyuni: brightness=${cuyuniMean}, pixels=${cuyuniCount}`); console.log(`Confluence: brightness=${confluenceMean}, pixels=${confluenceCount}`); // 7. Validate results if (cuyuniCount === 0 || confluenceCount === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after cloud masking.'); console.log('C2'); return; } if (cuyuniMean === null || confluenceMean === null || isNaN(cuyuniMean) || isNaN(confluenceMean)) { console.log('Calculation failed - invalid values.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // 8. Compare brightness if (cuyuniMean > confluenceMean) { console.log('Cuyuni River is lighter in color.'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('Cuyuni River is not lighter in color.'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
